patch.value: GH-1597: expose host-bound item transaction status and safe abandonment or supersession

GitHub https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1597 requests public recovery for interrupted item-mutation journals when a peer edit changes the retry plan. Existing bulk commit and guarded compensation are shipped; extend their public host-bound lifecycle rather than duplicating private journal storage or reviving completed implementation.

Expose typed host-bound journal state and applied/compensated step receipts with plan identity; Provide safe abandonment and supersession using proven apply markers and existing guarded compensation; never overwrite later peer edits or silently compensate committed work; Name executable public recovery in transaction-plan-mismatch guidance and verify non-Git crash/retry/peer-edit controls plus SDK contract documentation
Extensions can inspect and recover interrupted batches through a supported root-bound API without reading private paths or recreating journal and compensation rules.
